reviews.text:
The reservation system is convenient; they call you when your turn is approaching based on the estimated time, so you don't feel stressed by waiting. The nurses and veterinarians truly love animals and treat every dog ​​and cat gently, calling them by name.

The veterinarian is very kind and trustworthy! I was unsure about choosing a veterinary hospital, but since finding this one, I feel completely at ease!

The explanations during consultations are easy to understand, and during surgery, they explained everything in detail with illustrations, resolving all my questions. Thanks to them, I was able to entrust my beloved dog to the veterinarian with confidence, and contrary to my worries, my dog ​​was full of energy the next day! 😂

Regarding the fees, they seem slightly higher than other hospitals, but considering the veterinarian's extensive knowledge and skill, I think the peace of mind is well worth the money. I especially recommend the surgery. The scars healed beautifully.

I look forward to continuing to use their services in the future! 😊

I'm always grateful for the care I receive at Osaka Umeda Pet Clinic. This time, I visited for flea and tick prevention for my dog, and I was called in right away, so the waiting time was stress-free. The staff are very polite and reassuring. The veterinarian's explanation was easy to understand, and I was able to fully grasp the preventative measures. Overall, I'm always grateful for the courteous service I receive. I would like to continue using their services in the future. Thank you.

If you're looking for a veterinary clinic in Osaka City, I highly recommend considering this one. It's a wonderful clinic that truly puts the animal's well-being first and provides compassionate care.

My beloved cat, who is usually extremely fearful and has been treated as a problem child at every other clinic, was able to complete her examination and tests without any fear at all.

Because she feels most comfortable with her owner by her side, they performed procedures that other clinics would require leaving her in the examination room, and the doctor and nurses proceeded at a pace that suited her, talking to her throughout.

Thanks to their detailed explanations in easy-to-understand language, I was able to monitor her progress without any anxiety. I don't think there's another clinic like this. Five stars aren't enough! Thank you so much!

This is a hospital that will help you when you're really in trouble. If your pet's condition suddenly worsens, I recommend calling them even if it's outside of regular hours. The doctor is very kind and gentle, and seems like someone that animals and children would love. There is no parking lot, so it's best to park somewhere and walk, or get off at Nakatsu Station.

My cat swallowed something and vomited in the early morning. The emergency veterinary clinics were closed, so I left a message on their answering machine as a last resort.

They kindly called me back and listened to the situation.

I had managed to get an appointment at a hospital with an endoscope just before, so I didn't need their services, but I'm grateful for their kind and attentive response despite them having no prior visit history with my cat.

Thank you very much.

Both my cat and I are beginners when it comes to getting to know each other, and we've been going there since we were struggling to communicate properly. They always welcome us warmly and are always willing to give us advice on various things, so we feel at ease bringing our cats there.

I went to the clinic after reading Google reviews.

It was just as the reviews said.

The doctor is kind and thorough, and all the nurses are also kind and gentle.

It's clean, my dog ​​isn't scared and seems happy, so I've decided to bring him here from now on.

I've already decided that I want to enroll him in the puppy classes as well.

I'm looking forward to watching my dog ​​grow.

Please keep an eye on him.

This is a very trustworthy animal hospital.
It's close to my house, and I can leave my dog ​​there with peace of mind.
I recommend this place.

I took my 11-year-old Toy Poodle to the vet because I noticed her eyes were starting to look cloudy.

The doctor and nurses were all very kind, and my dog ​​was able to stay calm during the examination.

While we were waiting, the nurse kindly gave me lots of information about brushing her teeth.

I would definitely like to continue using their services in the future.

The vet is incredibly patient and truly loves animals. Every time we visit, he greets us with a big smile and is polite to everyone, locals and expats alike. I highly recommend him; the prices are also very reasonable. I also appreciate their attention to detail—they always post their holiday schedule clearly online and at the storefront.

They took care of my beloved cat from his hospitalization and treatment to his final care. Even though I was very nervous as this was the first time I had been treated like this, they were very kind and supportive, and calmly explained the situation and treatment plan to me, so I was able to make a treatment choice that I was happy with.
The staff were all very gentle and kind, and cared for both me and my cat with loving care.
I think this is a clinic I can confidently recommend to my friends.

All the nurses are incredibly kind and reassuring!❣️
They treat the animals that come to the hospital with such care, and seeing them speak to and pet the trembling animals to calm them down makes both Coco and I so grateful for having been connected to this hospital. And the doctors are amazing, too!👍
The first time we went, both Coco and I were nervous, but they were so friendly and easy to talk to, so we were able to leave Coco in their care with peace of mind.
They don't set aside time for each animal, but they listen carefully and treat them accordingly.
I've been a bit of a hospital refugee until now, but I hope to continue receiving their care from here on out.^_^
Thank you very much.🙇
The doctors are always very kind in their examinations, and my child has become very attached to the doctors and nurses.

I've been to many animal hospitals, but this is the only one!
They examine your beloved dog with compassion!
This hospital has a system called a treat pass, and is doing a great job of making sure dogs and cats don't dislike hospitals!
Of course, many of the nurses are animal lovers, so it's a hospital you can feel comfortable visiting!
They're giving away treats to people who follow them on Instagram and leave a review on Google Maps, so please come visit this hospital and post a review! ☺️
I was considering spaying my cat, so I came here for a pre-surgery checkup. The clinic was very clean, and the doctors and staff were very kind and polite.
The doctor and nurses were so kind and gave me such a thorough examination, which put me at ease. ☺️
The veterinarian and nurses are so kind and caring, and they treat my pet with such affection! Thank you so much for everything.

Conveniently located right next to Exit 1 of Nakatsu Station on the Osaka Metro Midosuji Line.

Appointments are made online (via LINE) on the morning of the day of your visit, and you'll be called when your turn is approaching.

While the waiting room is a bit small, this reservation system ensures that you won't be left without a seat.

The veterinarian and staff are kind and seem to take a stance of considering treatment and care tailored to each pet's condition and lifestyle.

They also focus on preventative care and maintaining health through health checkups and fitness programs, making them a family doctor that protects your pet's health not just after illness strikes.

The doctor and staff were very kind.

I appreciate the thorough examination and explanation.

It was easy to ask questions, and I felt at ease.
Thank you so much for always examining my cat so kindly and carefully. Thanks to everyone at the clinic, I can entrust my cat to you with complete peace of mind!

🐾The hospital that discovered Oh~chan's illness🏥✨
The doctors and nurses are incredibly caring💖
As a medical professional, I can vouch for this animal hospital and trust it wholeheartedly🐶🌸
by,🐶Oh~chan💓 …

In a word, it's a godsend hospital 🏥
We were told at a nearby hospital that our dog might have undescended testicles, so we were looking for a place to have him neutered when we found this hospital. It was our dog's first time coming to our home, so we were very worried and anxious as he wasn't used to it, but thanks to the incredibly kind and thorough doctor, nurses, and staff, the surgery was completed successfully, and now he's running around full of energy. At first, he seemed scared of the hospital, but now he loves it so much that he wags his tail excitedly when he goes there. They give him treats, play with him, and talk to him a lot, so they keep him entertained. There's also a doggy daycare and grooming on the third floor, so he's made lots of friends 🐶 We want to continue coming here if we need anything in the future.

My dog's condition suddenly worsened, and I desperately needed to get him examined. Everywhere I looked, the only available appointments were more than a week away. I was incredibly grateful that this clinic could see him on the same day.

Since they don't operate on an appointment system and see patients on a first-come, first-served basis, I was thankful they could see him that day.

This visit was more thorough than any other animal hospital I've ever been to.

They even immediately arranged an appointment with a specialist two days later.

While the thoroughness of their care means there's a bit of a wait, so it's best to allow ample time, it was a very good hospital. I would definitely use their services again.
The kind teachers make pet owners feel at ease☺️
It's a very good hospital where you can go with peace of mind. My dog ​​also enjoys going there.

I learned that the doctor was also knowledgeable in ophthalmology, so I went for a second opinion, and I felt that he was a very cheerful, kind, and trustworthy doctor, so I decided to have my dog ​​examined here. The nurses were also very kind and competent, and both the doctor and nurses spoke to my dog ​​gently at all times during the examination to make sure he wasn't anxious. The explanations and diagnoses were easy to understand, and the fees were reasonable, which impressed me. It's located right outside the station, and they see patients without appointments. The doctor has a wealth of knowledge and experience, is kind to both owners and dogs, listens carefully to patients, and explains the treatment plan in detail and with care. I'm so glad I found such a good hospital.

We have received a lot of help from them, including puppy classes, various vaccinations and preventative medicines, and treatment for ear infections and eye injuries.
Puppy classes were a great opportunity for him to interact with dogs of his same age and learn that the teachers and staff were kind, so he is growing up to be a dog that loves both people and dogs.
We were also grateful that they pointed out that his baby teeth were developing slowly, something we hadn't noticed when we first got him, and that a tumor was discovered at a specialist dentist. Going to puppy classes every week meant we could ask about even the smallest things, so it was a great opportunity for the owner as well.

We traveled to Osaka with our Hokkaido Ken for a vacation. We visited this clinic for a quick health exam for exporting documents 🐕

The doctor and staff are helpful and nice to us.
The doctor speaks good English and professional 👍
Highly recommend this clinic ❤️

We always take our cat here for checkups.

It's a new hospital, so the building is very clean, and the doctor always listens attentively to our concerns.

The doctor and nurses are all very kind to our cat, so she's able to relax during examinations.

The doctor is very knowledgeable and tries to address all of our concerns, so we feel confident entrusting our cat to them if anything happens.

I heard from my usual groomer (Shin-Osaka branch) that there's another location near Nakatsu Station that also has a veterinary hospital attached, so I visited for the first time since my usual hospital was closed.
My dog ​​had heart disease and was breathing shallowly and looking tired, so I took him here for a quick check-up.
The director and nurses are very kind.
The clinic is also clean.
You can make an appointment via LINE, so there's no need to wait in the clinic for long periods of time, which is great and stress-free.
They also listen carefully and answer any questions we have.
They spoke gently to my dog ​​during the ultrasound and injections so he wouldn't be scared, and the examination was very thorough.
The hospital we used to go to is a little far, so I think I'll be using this one instead.
The pulmonary edema from the heart disease has subsided, and he's doing great! lol
I look forward to continuing to support you.

We are grateful for your help with the puppy classes. It has been a very positive experience. Whenever we have problems raising our dog, you listen attentively and give us helpful advice, which is very much appreciated.

This is Sun, a male English Springer Spaniel. He's been coming here since he was 4 months old! Thanks to participating in puppy classes, he wags his tail excitedly when he enters the clinic. He doesn't like having his ears cleaned a little, but the doctor and nurses encourage him, and he does his best to get his medicine put in. We look forward to continuing to rely on your care!

I wanted to go there as soon as it opened, but I misunderstood and ended up waiting until April of this year. 😅 If only I had found out sooner... I wish I had started going sooner! I love this hospital so much. ☘️
I've been going there since April of this year, and the doctors and nurses are all so kind, gentle, and energetic, so I always have a great time. 😆
They have lots of animal events, and I go to the treat pass. Lately, it seems like my dog ​​has started to enjoy going to the hospital too. 🐶ᩚ
I hope he makes friends and grows up even more. ✨
Thank you so much for the drawings you did for him. 😊 I look forward to working with you in the future. ✨

Dear Ms. Chen Yingchao,
Thank you for visiting Osaka Umeda Pet Clinic.

Thank you so much for your 5-star rating. All of our staff are delighted that you trust us. We always strive to be a place where pets and their families can feel safe and secure, and we are committed to providing thorough examinations and heartfelt service. We will continue to work even harder to protect the health of your beloved pets. Please feel free to contact us if you have any concerns or questions. We look forward to serving you for many years to come.

Dear Mai Mai,
Thank you for visiting Osaka Umeda Pet Clinic.

Thank you so much for your high rating. It is a great encouragement to all of our staff. We value creating an environment where pets and their families can feel at ease, and we are dedicated to providing sincere care every day. We will continue to strive to be a trustworthy hospital by providing attentive care to each and every animal, offering clear and easy-to-understand explanations and warm support. If you have any concerns or questions, please do not hesitate to let us know. We look forward to your continued patronage.

I met a cool veterinarian and a kind nurse who was good at drawing. 
The prices were reasonable, so I'd like to make them my regular veterinarian! 
Thank you for answering my various questions so sincerely⭐️

I was feeling down after being told at another hospital that my right eye might be damaged, but then I found this hospital and came here. It was like a miracle, my eyes returned to their beautiful, round, black appearance. It was like magic had worked. I am so grateful. Thank you so much.

I brought my cat in because she wasn't feeling well.

The doctor and staff were incredibly kind and listened attentively to my concerns. They clearly explained the cause of my cat's illness and how to treat it, and their gentle approach to my cat showed how much they truly love animals.

My cat is now completely recovered, and I'm so glad I brought her in that day.

I plan to make this my regular vet from now on. Thank you very much.

Thank you for your continued support. Everyone is very kind. The doctor listens attentively to my concerns, and I feel at ease attending appointments. I can also book appointments on the same day through the app, so there's minimal waiting time. I look forward to continuing to use your services.

I've only been to this veterinary clinic in Nakatsu, but it's conveniently located, and the staff are incredibly helpful and pleasant.

The doctor has a wonderful personality. I've visited three different veterinary clinics since moving, and while all the doctors were good, this one is the most reassuring! I look forward to continuing to use their services.
The clinic is clean, and the doctor is kind, so I feel at ease going there.

My dog's tail tip was rotting, but it was cured with antibiotics. The male veterinarian kindly explained which medications were necessary and which were not.

We also use their services every year for heartworm testing and flea/tick medication. Thank you very much.

I visited for a second opinion, and the doctor explained the symptoms very clearly. They also discussed ways to minimize medical expenses while providing treatment.

They even spoke kindly to the reluctant kitten, showing their genuine love for animals, which made me feel at ease during treatment. Thank you!
He gave me a gentle diagnosis! I'm glad there were no injuries to my eyes!

The veterinarians and nurses are all very kind and understanding of pet owners' feelings.

They have a hotel and grooming service on-site, and the clinic is very clean.

They have events for dogs and offer treat passes, so even dogs that dislike vet visits will find it easy to go!
It's close to my home and I can always rely on it. The doctors and nurses are very kind and their service is polite and wonderful. I'll continue to rely on them!!!

Thank you for your continued support.

I really appreciate being able to make reservations via LINE and check the waiting time.

Also, the grooming salon on the 3rd floor is very convenient to use.

The veterinarians, nurses, and groomers are always kind and attentive, so my dog ​​always looks forward to coming.

The doctors and nurses are very kind, making it easy to discuss any anxieties or concerns.

The hospital is also easily accessible, which I appreciate!

The doctors and staff are very kind, so I feel I can leave my pet in their care with peace of mind. My pet has developed a genetic disease, but they explained future treatment plans and other matters in an easy-to-understand way, which put me at ease. I'm so grateful that a good pet clinic has opened nearby. I'm also grateful that they're open on Sundays.

The doctor and staff explain everything carefully.

They take care to ensure the dog doesn't feel uncomfortable during the examination.

This is a hospital where you can feel at ease.

My dog ​​fell ill during the New Year holidays, and since this clinic was open, we took him there for treatment. They performed blood tests and X-rays, thoroughly assessed his condition, and prescribed medication. The medication changes and subsequent tests were accurate, and he recovered remarkably quickly, regaining his full health!

They respected our wishes and the fact that he is a 12-year-old senior dog, and I believe they provided excellent treatment. I am truly grateful from the bottom of my heart.

The doctor and nurses are kind and gentle, and they listen attentively. I highly recommend this clinic!

The veterinarian is very kind, and he's treating my cat's cystitis there. It's also relatively close to my home, so I'm grateful that the animal hospital opened within walking distance. I would like to continue having my cats' health checked there in the future.

A new animal hospital opened nearby, and when I went there, the doctors and nurses were friendly, and the dog was so attached, it was wagging its tail! 🐶
The examinations were thorough and trustworthy.
I'll keep going there! 🏥 …

My beloved cat had never been properly examined at any vet before, as they would always say, "She's too unruly to be seen." However, thanks to the kind and attentive treatment from the doctor and nurses here, she was able to receive a calm examination.

This is the first time she's been able to receive treatment at an animal hospital.

Everyone at this clinic is so kind and gentle! ^_^
I was so impressed that even my timid cat wasn't scared or angry at all during the examination!

Thank you for your continued support!

This veterinary clinic opened around the same time we welcomed our puppy into our home, and we've been using their services for consultations, regular checkups, teeth-brushing lessons, and treat passes. It's a veterinary clinic we absolutely love.

I think Dr. Kato has a wonderful personality. He's always there for pets and their families, and he has such a kind demeanor that you feel you can talk to him about anything. The nurses are always cheerful and fun, and they do their work meticulously, so I trust them completely.

When I visited the clinic during its opening, I was impressed by Dr. Kato's extensive experience with eye diseases and the excellent equipment they have. I would recommend this clinic to anyone with a pet that has eye problems.

Thank you for treating my cat's uveitis.

Although it wasn't our regular vet, I took my cat in because she had some discomfort in her eye.

They used equipment such as eye pressure measurement and slit lamp examination to diagnose it early, and with eye drops, she recovered in less than a week and was completely cured in about three weeks.

They also carefully monitored her condition and kept her well-prepared until full recovery, which was a great help as I was very worried.

The doctor and nurses spoke kindly to my cat, making me feel at ease during my visits.

I'm also interested in dental training and would like to visit again if the opportunity arises.

Thank you very much.

My dog ​​has patellar luxation.
I've taken him to several hospitals before, but they couldn't give a definitive diagnosis, and I wasn't satisfied with many of the diagnoses. However, I felt at ease knowing that all the staff here love dogs, and they examined him very attentively, listening carefully to his detailed history and past events, and then they assessed his symptoms!

I have two Chihuahuas, ages 8 and 5, and I've been to several hospitals in Osaka before, but this was the best.

From now on, I plan to have them examined here and get medication and supplements from them.

I went here for a second opinion about my dog's eye injury. The doctor and nurses were very kind, and the doctor was polite and explained things clearly, and he examined me thoroughly. I was very worried, but I was really relieved. Thank you very much.
The clinic is also clean, and I think I'll make this my regular clinic.

This is a truly wonderful hospital.
Taking a sick cat or dog to the hospital is a very stressful experience for pet owners.
The doctors and nurses here are incredibly understanding and supportive of pet owners' feelings.
This time, my cat received care here, but in the past, my family has kept many cats and dogs and taken them to several hospitals. However, none of the hospitals I've visited have been as kind and warm as the doctors and nurses here.
From the examination and diagnosis to the explanation of the treatment, everything is explained very clearly. You can also check the waiting list and make reservations via LINE, so there's no stress from waiting, which is very reassuring.

Until now, I thought that if my cat was healthy, there was no need to take her to the hospital because it would only cause stress. However, after she was diagnosed with kidney stones, I've come to realize that even after her symptoms improve, I want to maintain her health by having regular blood tests and other checkups.
Choosing a hospital for cats is more difficult than for humans, so finding a hospital where we can go with peace of mind feels like a miracle.
Thank you so much.

Thank you for your continued support. Recently, I came here for patella surgery and post-operative rehabilitation.
My child loves the doctors and is full of energy as soon as he steps in the …

I requested a spaying surgery.

She's a very timid dog, but there were no problems after the surgery. Thank you for your kind and attentive care!
Just recently, I had my beloved dog's first spay surgery performed at your clinic. …
This hospital is kind and thorough, and they explain things in an easy-to-understand way.

We've been taking our dog here since he was a puppy.

He's a timid dog, but the vet and nurses are so kind that we plan to keep going back. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic!!

Thank you so much for accepting my senior dog.

The doctor and nurses were so kind (*^^*) …

I started coming to this hospital through a snack pass, and the nurses and doctors are so kind and create an atmosphere that doesn't feel like a hospital, so it's always a big help. 🥹
Thank you as always. 😊 …
The teachers and staff are all so kind, and I feel completely at ease going there.😌 I look forward to continuing to use your services in the future.🐕✨ …
